definition: Not measured; technically complete synthetic advisory inputs are a pipeline-eligibility proxy only and do not establish that a person can access or use the software.
scope_and_limitations: No account, device, connectivity, uptake, or accessibility audit data.

source_fields: Generated scheduling requests and interval traces
definition: Count unique synthetic household/scenario inputs that passed request validation.
scope_and_limitations: Pipeline eligibility does not establish a person's ability to use the advisory service.

definition: Technical feasibility/completion only: the schedule is feasible and all mandatory tasks complete. Practical user actionability is not measured.
scope_and_limitations: A technical result only; it is not user acceptance, practical actionability, or device execution.

definition: Not classified; no minimum acceptable benefit or welfare threshold is declared.
scope_and_limitations: A modeled cost reduction does not establish that shifting is worthwhile to a user.

definition: No user confirmation, acceptance, access, or ability-to-act observations.
scope_and_limitations: Technical feasibility does not establish practical actionability or adoption.

definition: The experiment does not dispatch devices or verify task completion in a home.
scope_and_limitations: No device execution telemetry is included.

definition: Absolute modeled energy-charge reduction from the same case's S0, in AUD; not a full bill or verified household saving.
scope_and_limitations: AUD values are modeled energy-charge differences, not complete bills or verified savings.

definition: Only generated scenario categories (flexibility hours and appliance mix) are used; no demographic or socioeconomic groups are inferred.
scope_and_limitations: Synthetic design labels only; they do not represent protected or socioeconomic groups.

definition: No real demographic group labels are used.
scope_and_limitations: No consented demographic data, collection purpose, or provenance documentation exists.

definition: Not estimable: source profiles do not encode PV generation, battery storage, or a verified DER-ownership category. EV charging is only a modeled load task.
scope_and_limitations: No PV/BESS/generation/DER ownership fields; EV is modeled as a flexible load.
